name: pabandi-mcp
description: PabandiOS MCP Server — Trust operating system for service businesses. Provides trust scoring, escrow, booking, freight, property, and CRM tools for AI agents.

tools.name: pabandi_verify_passport
tools.description: Verify a Pabandi PTP attestation (agent, business, individual, or trust rail).

tools.name: pabandi_discover
tools.description: Return the Pabandi Trust Protocol discovery document.

tools.name: pabandi_get_ledger
tools.description: Public audit lookup of a passport issuance charge by idempotency key.

tools.name: pabandi_issue_passport
tools.description: Issue a scoped Agent Capability Passport. Metered at 1.0 USDC per issue.

tools.name: pabandi_verify_property
tools.description: Verify property documents and landlord/tenant trust scores against PLRA and SBCA databases.

tools.name: pabandi_initiate_escrow
tools.description: Initiate a Solana escrow for conditional payment.

tools.name: pabandi_create_booking
tools.description: Create a booking with AI trust scoring and escrow protection. Requires AP2 mandates.
